course.title: Unit 1 How can I get there?-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（How to get to the place?）

sentences.content: I know a great Italian restaurant.
sentences.english: I know a great Italian restaurant
sentences.chinese: 我知道一家很棒的意大利餐厅。

sentences.content: It’s next to the park on Dongfang Street.
sentences.english: It's next to the park on Dongfang Street
sentences.chinese: 它位于Dongfang Street的公园旁边。

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 转向

sentences.content: Then turn right at the hospital.
sentences.english: Then turn right at the hospital

sentences.content: How can I get to the … ?
sentences.english: How can I get to the ...?

wordDetails.definition: 短语动词原型: 转向

sentences.content: Now we are in front of Tian’anmen.
sentences.english: Now we are in front of Tian'anmen
sentences.chinese: 现在我们来到了天安门前。

sentences.content: Go straight and you can see the Palace Museum.
sentences.english: Go straight and you can see the Palace Museum
sentences.chinese: 直走就能看到故宫博物院。

sentences.content: Which of these can help you find a place?
sentences.english: Which of these can help you find a place ?
sentences.chinese: 以下哪项能帮你找到某个地方？

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

sentences.content: Wu Binbin’s grandpa gave Robin a new feature.
sentences.english: Wu Binbin's grandpa gave Robin a new feature
sentences.chinese: 吴彬彬的爷爷给Robin添加了一个新功能。

sentences.content: He can help the boys find the Italian restaurant.
sentences.english: He can help the boys find the Italian restaurant
sentences.chinese: 他能帮男孩们找到那家Italian餐厅。

sentences.content: We’re in front of the cinema.
sentences.english: We're in front of the cinema

sentences.content: Let’s go straight and turn left at the bookstore.
sentences.english: Let's go straight and turn left at the bookstore
sentences.chinese: 我们直走，然后在书店左转。

sentences.content: No. Now we are behind the hospital.
sentences.english: No . Now we are behind the hospital
sentences.chinese: 不，现在我们在医院后面。

sentences.content: Let’s turn right and then turn right again.
sentences.english: Let's turn right and then turn right again
sentences.chinese: 我们先右转，然后再右转一次。

wordDetails.definition: work（第三人称单数）: 工作

sentences.content: But let’s eat first. I’m so hungry!
sentences.english: But let's eat first . I'm so hungry !
sentences.chinese: 不过咱们先吃饭吧，我饿坏了！
